verdict.rationale: Paddle has robust first-party webhook documentation: real-time push notifications for account events, signature verification via Paddle-Signature header, IP allowlisting guidance, and SDK helpers (Node.js, Python) for verifying webhook signatures. MCP tooling also explicitly supports 'configure webhooks, and simulate events for testing,' making this agent-accessible. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of webhook reliability or agent-driven webhook subscription workflows beyond vendor docs.
